crm.name: Wakeel CRM
crm.title: A smart CRM that runs your sales and support from your phone
crm.desc: Every client, appointment, invoice and support ticket in one place. Leads flow in automatically from your ad campaigns, and AI tells you who is closest to buying and what to do next.
highlights: Automatic lead capture from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp and your website forms
AI lead score from 0 to 100, with a negotiation summary and an alert when contact goes quiet
Quotes and tax invoices as Arabic-ready PDFs, sent to the client over WhatsApp
Live KPIs: conversion rate, response time and loss rate for every team member

ai.desc: Scores every lead, summarizes negotiation history and WhatsApp chats, and suggests the next step, plus an AI sales manager that analyzes your whole company.

leads.title: Leads arrive on their own
leads.desc: Direct connection to Meta and TikTok lead ads, your website forms and landing pages, with duplicate-number detection and a full log of every capture.

profile.title: A 360° profile for every client
profile.desc: Stage, priority and rating (hot / warm / cold), contacts, files and tasks, comments with @mentions, and a timeline that logs every move automatically.

reports.title: Reports & KPIs
reports.desc: Conversion rate, average first response, days to close, and performance by source and by employee, exportable to Excel and PDF.

appointments.title: Organized appointments
appointments.desc: Meetings, calls and field visits with status tracking, rescheduling and a 7-day upcoming view.

invoices.title: Quotes & invoices
invoices.desc: Line items, discounts and 15% VAT, Arabic PDF invoices sent over WhatsApp, and partial payments by cash, transfer, card or cheque.

tickets.title: Tickets & satisfaction ratings
tickets.desc: Numbered tickets with categories and automatic SLA deadlines, opened straight from WhatsApp chats, with 1–5 star ratings from your customers.

inventory.title: Inventory linked to your ERP
inventory.desc: Scan barcodes, check stock before you sell, and push invoices to your ERP automatically.

trust: Fully isolated data for every company

whatsapp.name: Wakeel WhatsApp
whatsapp.tag: Customer service & conversation management on WhatsApp
whatsapp.title: Every WhatsApp conversation in one inbox, routed to your team and tracked as a ticket until it's solved
whatsapp.desc: A shared inbox for all your numbers, automatic routing to the agents on shift, and a ticket for every request that closes with a satisfaction rating and an AI summary sent to your CRM.

pillars.title: Shared team inbox
pillars.desc: Real-time chats from all your numbers, with internal notes and quick replies

pillars.title: A ticket for every chat
pillars.desc: Opened automatically on the customer's message, then assigned and closed inside the chat

pillars.title: Shift-aware routing
pillars.desc: Round-robin or least-busy, and only to agents who are on shift

pillars.title: Ratings & AI summaries
pillars.desc: A satisfaction survey on close and an AI summary sent to your CRM

whatsapp.officialNote: Works with Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API, with support for multiple numbers

float.ticketMeta: AI summary: payment confirmed, order shipped

inbox.title: A shared inbox for all your numbers
inbox.desc: Every WhatsApp chat lands in real time on one screen your team works from together: filter by number, tag and stage, leave internal notes the customer never sees, answer with quick-reply shortcuts, send voice notes and media, and rename contacts.

tickets.title: Tickets managed inside the chat
tickets.desc: A ticket opens automatically with the first message, with a category, subject and unique number. It's assigned to the first agent who replies, reopens when the customer comes back, and closes automatically after 12 to 72 hours of inactivity.

routing.title: Teams & shifts
routing.desc: Link each number to a team, define shifts and working days, and route chats round-robin or to the least-busy agent, sending returning customers back to the same agent.

visibility.title: Conversation privacy
visibility.desc: Decide what each agent sees: every conversation, their team's conversations, or only those assigned to them, plus 15 adjustable permissions.

csat.title: Customer satisfaction ratings
csat.desc: An automatic survey after a ticket closes, in three formats: an interactive star list, quick buttons or a text reply. The rating is saved and sent to your CRM.

ai.title: AI summary for every ticket
ai.desc: When a ticket closes, AI summarizes the issue and its resolution in two lines and sends it to your CRM.

crm.title: Synced with Wakeel CRM
crm.desc: The customer is created in your CRM automatically, and tickets, summaries and ratings are synced to their profile.

bot.title: Auto-reply bot
bot.desc: Keyword rules that work around the clock, respond to button taps and list picks, and can be tied to a specific campaign.

campaigns.title: Official WhatsApp campaigns via Meta
campaigns.desc: Launch campaigns to thousands of customers with Meta-approved templates: personal variables for every customer from an Excel file or a contact group, send now or schedule, and track sent, read and failed counts for every campaign, within Meta's daily limits and with clear pricing per category. Campaigns over a QR connection, paced to protect your number from bans, are available too.

templates.title: Meta templates & WhatsApp Flows
templates.desc: Create templates and submit them for approval in-app, start from 7 ready-made ones, and build interactive Flows for bookings, surveys and lead capture.

api.title: API & webhooks for developers
api.desc: A documented REST API with secure keys, plus instant webhooks for incoming messages and sent, delivered and read receipts, with automatic retries.

ecosystem.title: When WhatsApp meets your CRM, no lead slips away
ecosystem.desc: Connect both products and every conversation automatically becomes organized data your team can act on.
